guesses.reason: Small sturdy body, short flat-ish muzzle, large dark round eyes, and a long shaggy facial coat with beard and mustache point strongly to Shih Tzu ancestry.
The salt-and-pepper gray head with a pronounced beard and the bluish-gray skin patches showing through the shaved body suggest Schnauzer influence.
The wiry, scruffy whiskered face, prominent dark eyes, and slightly upturned short muzzle resemble a bearded Griffon.

breed.appearance: A small, compact dog with a freshly shaved body showing white fur over mottled bluish-gray skin patches, and a thin, upward-curving tail with a darker gray tip. The head is left fluffy and scruffy in dark charcoal-gray with lighter silver strands, featuring a short muzzle, a bushy white-tinged beard and drooping mustache, small folded ears hidden in the fur, and big round shiny dark-brown eyes looking up. Gizmo wears a teal nylon collar clipped to a bright orange leash and stands on short white legs with fluffy paws.
breed.fun_fact: Shih Tzus were bred as cherished companions of Chinese royalty, so Gizmo comes from a long line of professional lap-warmers!
